subtitle: Agentic payments are changing the payment UX from human-clicked transactions to delegated, bounded, auditable AI execution — forcing banks to redesign consent, authentication, dispute handling, and liability.
description: Agentic payments in 2026 have moved from concept to live transaction. The banking challenge is no longer whether AI agents can initiate payments, but how consent, liability, identity, auditability, fraud controls, and protocol interoperability should work.
excerpt: Agentic payments crossed from concept to live transaction in 2026 — Mastercard and Rabobank executed a Netherlands AI-agent payment via Agent Pay, AP2-style cryptographic mandates are emerging, and HM Treasury says payment-services regulation must adapt. The banking architecture question is consent, identity, liability, and pre-settlement evidence.
